text:
elaine: FYI — scorecard diff for quantized run looks wrong. quant-v2:int8 shows -23% QA_score on the 'short_dialog' bucket :eyes:  https://console.redwood/scorecards/quant-v2/diff?bucket=short_dialog

maya: I was just in the drilldown — it lists 0 samples for that cohort but the parent card says 72. UI bug?

sanjay: seen that. clicking export samples yields an empty CSV. suspect the drilldown query is filtering on a different variant key.

ryan: could be a mapping mismatch between runner artifact manifest and the scorecard renderer. runner writes variant names with colons (e.g., "quant-v2:int8") but renderer queries normalized names.

sanjay: here's the runner upload log from the failed run:
```
INFO 2026-03-17T13:02:11 runner: uploading eval/artifacts/1945_.../manifest.json
ERROR  upload failed: 403 forbidden -> path contains ':' -> skipping
```
Looks like the cloudstore sanitizer rejects ':' in object names so manifest never made it.

maya: @sanjay can you paste the manifest snippet you saw?

sanjay: manifest snippet:
```
{"variants": [{"name": "quant-v2:int8", "id": "qv2:int8"}], "buckets": {"short_dialog": {"count": 72}}}
```

harper: :bug: aha — colons in variant names. We sanitize file paths when writing to object store but we don't normalize the keys inside the manifest. Renderer expects normalized_variant_name which is used in the drilldown query, so it returns 0 rows.

ryan: quick fix plan: normalize_variant_name() in runner before emitting manifest + unit test. I'll open a PR. Also add a fallback that retries upload with sanitized path.

ci-bot: CI job #12418 finished with status: failure
Logs: https://ci.redwood/12418
Artifacts: partial upload (manifest missing)

maya: Until the runner patch lands, workaround: re-run the eval with --variant-name safe string (quant-v2-int8) or set env RUNNER_SANITIZE_VARIANT=true in the job. That should make the manifest available.

elaine: Can the frontend add a guard? If drilldown sample count == 0 but parent count > 0 show a small warning and link to artifacts + explain mismatch. Saves debugging time.

harper: agree. I'll file a tiny frontend ticket and add a tooltip: "zero samples usually means artifact/query tag mismatch".

ryan: PR opened: https://git.redwood/p/r/456 -> adds normalize + tests, and a runner flag --archive-fallback to retry sanitized paths.

elaine: OK I'm going to re-run the quantization eval with a sanitized variant name and confirm. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
